name: Hollow Men Figures
placementTarget: On the board legend, sticker area 15.
summary: Title HOLLOW MEN FIGURES, with a Hollow Men shield. Three reminders: your character is exposed when your pawn leaves a location that contains 1 or more Hollow Men figures; instead of adding a 4th figure to a city, reduce its population by 1; if a location has 1 or more Hollow Men figures or Plague cubes, reduce its population by only 1 during step 1 of Game End. The number 15 is not printed on the sticker.

mechanics.timing: Leaving a Hollow Men location, placing a 4th figure, and Game End step 1.
mechanics.effect: Board reminder of three rules from this package. Leaving a location with 1 or more Hollow Men figures exposes the character. A 4th figure is not placed, and that city loses 1 population immediately. At Game End step 1, a location with Hollow Men figures or Plague cubes loses only 1 population.
restrictions: This sticker does not add a rule beyond C, G, S, T, and W. It repeats the leave exposure, the 3-figure cap, and the single Game End population drop.
The Game End bullet says figures or Plague cubes, and only 1. Rule W is the rulebook wording of that combined drop.
